title: Sports lab 3 (source of the round-3 templates)
summary: The 8 comps the round-3 Sports templates were built and verified in: live score clock, substitution card, signing announcement, touchdown burst, tournament bracket, league table movement, fixture list and match-day poster.
use_when: You want to see a round-3 sports template working before using it, copy a comp's objects (the confetti physics, the bracket joins, the table climb), or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py after changing its copy.
parameters: team colours (linear light; text colours converted with BT.709)
text content (sample copy: teams, players, leagues and scores are invented)
confetti: count, speed, drag and gravity (regenerate; baked every 2 f)
clock: the six one-second clips are separate texts (text.content cannot be keyed)
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-28
copy_notes: No media; nothing to relink. The player in SP Signing and the crests in SP Match day are shape stand-ins.
Comps have a 'Lab bg' rectangle (dropped on extraction).
Clip ids are unique per comp (slc_, ssu_, ssg_, stb_, sbr_, stm_, sfx_, smd_).
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/sports_lab3.py writes the comps; every move is baked as keys (no presets to apply); open with edit.open {force:true}, then edit.save.
Every comp lints 0 errors / 0 warnings with contrast:true (notes: repeated_key_value on holds, speed_jump on the table climb; intended).
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-28
